notes: Sheet is turned: north is to the LEFT (Spring Grove Av., the east side, runs across the top; Alabama Av. is the vertical street at the left; Stock Av. at the right). Alabama is 25' west of Spring Grove (printed) and ~50 ft east of it (unlabelled, corner centre used). The two openings on the east side of Spring Grove between Alabama and Stock: the second is printed ETHAN (written Ethan Avenue per the key map 'ETHAN AV.'); the first (x~2522, ~50 ft, water pipe) is not named on this sheet and is Bates Av. per the key map (block 279). Johnson appears twice: the 50-ft street meeting Alabama from the north (left edge, printed JOHNSON, no width) and the 27' street that starts at the foot of Stock Av. at the right edge and runs south onto sheet 304. They are separate, offset pieces with the abattoir/stockyard block between them, so they carry qualifiers '(north of Alabama)' and '(south of Stock)'. Stock Av. (16') ends at Johnson and Johnson begins there (an L-corner, recorded as T). The dash-dot line A-B at x~6100 is a match line, not a street; the dashed 'Cattle Drive' is private. Alabama continues straight to the bottom edge with no other cross streets (railroad crosses at y~3800-4700).
